description: GearHost CloudSite plans and monthly prices in USD, read live from GearHost (the free plan included). Each plan: name, monthly_price_usd, disk_mb, monthly_requests (null = no fixed limit). Every plan, including free, can use custom domains with automatic HTTPS. Add-on prices (email, high availability, databases) are per plan. Plans are changed in the GearHost panel (the CloudSite's "Change plan" link); this tool only reads prices. pricing_model states how billing works: flat monthly prices, no credits or usage charges, and what happens when a site passes its request limit. Returns structuredContent { status, currency, plans:[...], pricing_model, change_plan }.
name: get_plans
title: Get plans and prices
